units.source_text: 那天晚上，大家都是过了十一点才熄灯休息。

en.t: That night, everyone turned out the lights and went to bed only after eleven o'clock.

units.source_text: 但是，我闭上眼睛之后，无论如何都睡不着。

en.t: But after I closed my eyes, I could not fall asleep no matter what.

units.source_text: 哥哥已经数次警告我不准我提起雏人偶的事情了，我对再看一眼雏人偶的要求也已经死心了。

en.t: My elder brother had already warned me several times not to bring up the dolls, and I had given up asking to see them once more.

units.source_text: 但是，我想再看一眼雏人偶的想法也丝毫没有改变。

en.t: Even so, my desire to see the dolls once more had not changed in the slightest.

units.source_text: 明天，雏人偶就要被送到遥远的别人家了——只要想到这件事，我的眼泪就止不住的流下来。

en.t: Tomorrow the dolls would be sent away to some far-off household, and whenever I thought of it my tears would not stop flowing.

units.source_text: 要不然等大家都睡着了，我自己偷偷拿出来看一眼。

en.t: Perhaps I should wait until everyone was asleep, secretly take them out myself, and have one more look.
That thought had crossed my mind.

units.source_text: 或者把某一个雏人偶拿出来，偷偷藏起来。

en.t: Or perhaps I could take out one of the dolls and secretly hide it away.

units.source_text: 但是不管是哪一样，一旦被发现——想到这个可能，我就忍不住一阵战栗。

en.t: But whichever I did, if I were discovered, the mere thought of that possibility made me shudder uncontrollably.

units.source_text: 老实说，我这一辈子从未像那一晚，脑子里想的都是奇奇怪怪的想法。

en.t: To be honest, never in my life had my mind been so filled with strange ideas as it was that night.

units.source_text: 譬如：倘若今晚来一场大火就好了。

en.t: For example, I wished a great fire might break out that very night.

units.source_text: 在没有把雏人偶交出去之前，就把它们都烧光了。

en.t: Before the dolls were handed over, the fire would burn them all to ashes.

units.source_text: 或者那个住在横滨的美国人和丸佐店的老板都得了霍乱。

en.t: Or the American who lived in Yokohama and the owner of the Marusa shop might both come down with cholera.

units.source_text: 要是这样的话，雏人偶就不用被送走了，还会好好地留在我家里。

en.t: If that happened, the dolls would not have to be sent away and would remain safely in my house.

units.source_text: ——我想的都是这些荒谬的想法。

en.t: Those were the absurd thoughts that filled my mind.

units.source_text: 但是，无论如何当时我还是一个孩子，约莫不到一个小时，我就迷迷糊糊的睡着了。

en.t: But after all, I was still a child then, and in less than an hour I drifted drowsily off to sleep.
